body:
Talwar Thakore & Associates advised Macquarie.

Latham & Watkins and S&R Associates have advised Canadian pension fund Caisse de dépôt et placement du Québec (CDPQ) on its sale of units in Indian infrastructure trust Maple to Macquarie Asset Management for $450 million.

Established in 2021, Maple owns and operates seven toll roads across six states in Eastern, Northern, and Southern India through long-term concession frameworks, according to a company statement.

Following completion of the transaction, Macquarie Asset Management and CDPQ will jointly own controlling stakes in Maple's investment manager and project manager.

Latham & Watkins' team was led by partner Sidharth Bhasin, with associates I-Ming Tan and Andrew Lee.

Talwar Thakore & Associates' transaction team comprised partners Gautam Saha and Shivranjani Ralawata, senior associate Shamik Gupta, and associate Megha Rana. The projects team comprised partner Akshay Malhotra, senior associate Aishik Majumder, and associate Kopal Bhargava. The competition team comprised partner Sonam Mathur, managing associate Shubhang Joshi, and associates Saikishan Rathore and Shashank Mehrotra.

S&R Associates' team was led by partners Rajat Sethi and Pratichi Mishra, and included associates Samyak Jain, Durga Prasad Mohapatra, and Aiman Singh. Head of competition practice Simran Dhir, partner Akshat Kulshrestha, and associates Prerana De, Sehaj Mahajan, and Ritik Mohapatra advised on competition law matters.
